It yields one actual critical 0-cell and 64 critical 4-cells after deleting the augmented-empty pair. Forman theory yields the asserted integral homotopy equivalence to a wedge of 64 S4. Finite classification is genuinely exhaustive after enumerating all 3^9 edge states; mod-two ranks alone are not its proof.
